title: Pinhole-top poles (southern two-thirds)
description: Concrete poles with a row of holes running up to the very top ('pinhole top') are found only in the southern two-thirds of Vietnam, from Quang Binh southwards. The north uses poles without holes at the top.

title: Khanh Hoa electrical boxes
description: This electrical box with a window and small ventilation slots on the side is unique to Khanh Hoa province (Nha Trang area) in south-central Vietnam.

title: Black pole stickers (far north)
description: Poles with a black number sticker are found in the northern quarter of Vietnam: the northern mountains and the Red River Delta, reaching into Thanh Hoa.

title: Mini-bar poles (north)
description: Poles carrying several short stacked crossarms ('mini-bars', like in Czechia/Slovakia) are found in northern Vietnam, from the Chinese border down to Ha Tinh and more rarely Quang Binh.

title: Trapezoid crossarm poles (northern three-quarters)
description: Trapezoid-shaped crossarms braced from the pole (North Sulawesi style) are found in the northern three-quarters of Vietnam, from the north down to the Central Highlands and Ninh Thuan; they are absent from the southeast and the Mekong Delta.

title: Poles without holes at the top (north and centre)
description: Concrete poles whose top section has no holes are found in the northern half of Vietnam, extending down through the central coast and the Central Highlands (rarer in Phu Yen and Khanh Hoa). In the south the poles have holes all the way up.

title: Thin bamboo poles (northern mountains)
description: Thin bamboo poles are found in the northern quarter of Vietnam, in the mountains, mostly in the far northwest (Lai Chau, Dien Bien, Son La, Lao Cai, Ha Giang) and less often in the other northern mountain provinces.

title: Single-brace poles (far south)
description: Poles with a crossarm held by a single diagonal brace (similar to some seen in Brazil) are found only in the southern quarter of Vietnam: the southeast (Ho Chi Minh City region, Binh Thuan) and the Mekong Delta.

title: Trident double-brace poles (far south)
description: Trident-shaped poles whose crossarm is held by two diagonal braces (West Kalimantan style) are found in the southern quarter of Vietnam: the southeast, Binh Thuan and the Mekong Delta, with rare occurrences in Gia Lai and Binh Dinh.

title: Curved metal awnings (south, plus Sơn La and Phú Thọ)
description: Metal awnings with a curved end are found in southern Vietnam, plus the Sơn La and Phú Thọ areas in the north (yellow dots on the map; red = flat awnings).

title: Flat-ended metal awnings (north)
description: Metal awnings with a flat end are found in northern Vietnam (red dots on the map; yellow = curved awnings).

title: Flat awnings with a sawtoothed/patterned bottom (Nghệ An)
description: Flat awnings with a sawtoothed or patterned bottom edge are found in Nghệ An and neighbouring areas.

title: Indented roof tiles (north and centre)
description: Indented roof tiles are found in the north and centre of Vietnam.

title: Round overlapping roof tiles (north-east of Hanoi)
description: Round overlapping roof tiles are fairly common north-east of Hanoi.

title: Diamond scale roof tiles (Mường Lay area)
description: Diamond scale tiles are found in the Mường Lay area (Điện Biên and Lai Châu provinces), and some in Thanh Hóa. Needs more research.

title: Wooden shingle roofs (western Lào Cai, north-west Nghệ An)
description: Wooden shingle roofs are found in pockets in western Lào Cai and north-western Nghệ An.

title: Square or flat raised roof ornaments (Red River Delta)
description: Square or flat raised ornaments on the roof ridge are found in the Red River Delta (yellow dots on the map).

title: Arrow-shaped roof ornaments (south and centre)
description: Arrow-shaped, or rarely rounded, roof ornaments are found in southern and central Vietnam (red dots on the map).

title: Raised gables joined by a raised ridge bar (Mekong, Đà Nẵng)
description: Roofs with raised gables or ridge ends connected by a raised bar along the central ridge, unadorned (no elaborate temple ornamentation): Mekong Delta and Đà Nẵng. May need further research.

title: Houses with thatch walls (southern Mekong Delta)
description: Houses with thatched walls are found in the southern Mekong Delta.

title: Simple wooden houses (Central Highlands)
description: The Central Highlands have lots of very simple wooden houses, often with (1) a gable of wooden boards set diagonally, parallel to the roof, and/or (2) the short side of the house made of several columns of short horizontal boards.

title: Steeply angled gable wall ends (central Gia Lai)
description: Steeply angled gable wall ends, shingled, metal or otherwise, are found in central Gia Lai (the province as merged in 2025, around An Khê).

title: Metal squares covering the beam ends (coastal Gia Lai, Đà Nẵng)
description: Metal squares covering the ends of the roof beams are found in coastal Gia Lai (former Bình Định) and Đà Nẵng (including former Quảng Nam).

title: Katu longhouses (western Huế and Đà Nẵng)
description: Katu longhouses (nhà gươl), with rounded corners and sometimes curved gable horns, are found in western Huế and western Đà Nẵng.

title: Side gables with a row of pointed tiles (southern Nghệ An)
description: Side gables topped with a row of pointed tiles are found mostly in southern Nghệ An.

title: Tile-topped raised gables (mostly Nghệ An)
description: Tile-topped raised gables are also found mostly in Nghệ An, but are less reliable (occasionally further north or south).

title: Roof windows with an inner 'shelf' (western Nghệ An)
description: Roof windows with an additional 'shelf' of roof material inside are found in western Nghệ An, and rarely north of Hanoi.

title: Raised ridges in the middle of roofs (southern Ninh Bình, Quảng Trạch)
description: Raised ridges in the middle of the roof slope are found in southern Ninh Bình (the province as merged in 2025) and around Quảng Trạch.

title: Thatched houses with roof windows (western Nghệ An/Thanh Hóa, Tuyên Quang)
description: Thatched houses with roof windows have two main pockets: western Nghệ An / Thanh Hóa, and around Tuyên Quang.
